Committed as `9cac7125d937c13ce2c9b444ef5a7ea8ba5f5f9e` on branch `feat/scan-scheduler`. Remaining unstaged changes are unrelated `.pHive` session/telemetry artifacts, not part of this story, so left untouched.

## Summary

Built the `scan-scheduler` story end to end:

**`src/scheduler/backoff.ts`** — `BackoffTracker`: per-source in-memory exponential backoff, doubling per consecutive failure, capped at 24h (`DEFAULT_MAX_BACKOFF_MS`), resetting to the base interval on first success. Fully injectable clock (`now`), no real timers in the core logic.

**`src/scheduler/index.ts`** — `startScheduler()`: registers all 8 built-in source adapters once at startup (same dynamic-import-inside-`main()` pattern as `runner.ts`, documented as a deliberate update from the story text's stale "4" figure), reads `Config` only via `loadConfig()`. Idles and rechecks hourly (`DEFAULT_IDLE_RECHECK_MS`) instead of exiting when `Config.schedule` is unset; otherwise schedules `runRadar()` via `croner` (`new Cron(pattern, { timezone, catch }, fn)` — API confirmed against the real installed package's `.d.ts`/README first). Each cycle builds an in-memory-only, backoff-filtered `Config` (`buildCycleConfig()`) before calling `runRadar()`. A top-level fatal boundary (`fatal()`) catches anything outside `runRadar()`'s own per-source handling and calls an injectable `exitFn` (real `process.exit(1)` in production). Logs a per-cycle summary (gigs found/passed, per-source errors, skipped-for-backoff sources, backoff states).

**`package.json`** — added `"scheduler": "NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-sqlite tsx src/scheduler/index.ts"`.

**`docs/scheduler-launchd-template.plist`** + a new "Scheduler" section in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — a real, copy-pasteable macOS launchd template with only generic `<<placeholder>>` values, plus the roadmap checkbox flipped to done.

**Tests** (26 new, all passing): `backoff.test.ts` (doubling/cap/reset with a fake clock), `index.test.ts` (idle-not-exit with injectable timer, cron created with correct pattern/timezone, a real short-interval firing, `job.trigger()`-based backoff-filtering and reset-on-success across cycles, config.json byte-for-byte-unchanged regression, fatal-exit for a thrown error/malformed cron/`loadConfig` throw), and `no-save-config.test.ts` (grep-verifiable: no call/import of `saveConfig`, and the only `config/` import anywhere in `src/scheduler` is `loadConfig`).

`npm test`: 534 passed, 3 pre-existing skipped (45 files, 1 pre-existing skipped file, unrelated). `npm run typecheck`: clean.
